**🩺 Stability & Availability** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**

**End the span when the stream closes before its first item.**

If a caller closes the generator returned by `_wrap` without calling `next`, Python never enters this `try/finally`. `_wrap` has already started the span, so the span remains unfinished. Give the returned stream a `close()` path that ends the span even when iteration has not started, and test that case.
